title: implement RMSprop

atoms.evidence: self.params = list(params)  # turn params into a list (because it might be a generator)
self.b = [t.zeros_like(p) for p in self.params]; self.v = [t.zeros_like(p) for p in self.params] — two buffers per param
for p in self.params: p.grad = None
theta -= self.lr * g  # inplace operation, to modify params
v.copy_(self.alpha * v + (1 - self.alpha) * g.pow(2))  # inplace operation, to modify value in self.v ; b.copy_(self.mu * b + g)
if self.lmda != 0: g = g + self.lmda * theta — same L2 weight decay fold as SGD
v.copy_(self.alpha * v + (1 - self.alpha) * g.pow(2)) — EMA of squared gradients, RMSprop's v; pseudocode 'v_t <- alpha*v_{t-1} + (1-alpha)*g_t^2'
g = g / (v.sqrt() + self.eps) — per-coord adaptive scaling with eps floor; pseudocode 'g_t <- g_t / (sqrt(v_t) + epsilon)'
if self.mu > 0: b.copy_(self.mu * b + g); g = b — classical momentum reused; pseudocode 'b_t <- mu*b_{t-1} + g_t'
if self.lmda != 0 / if self.mu > 0 — both conditional hparam shortcuts retained

f'RMSprop(lr={self.lr}, eps={self.eps}, momentum={self.mu}, weight_decay={self.lmda}, alpha={self.alpha})' — provided in template
